description: Deterministic safety rules preventing destructive mutations and unauthorized database operations

rules.name: Block Destructive DDL and Truncation Queries
rules.description: Strictly prohibits DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, or schema deletions by autonomous agents.

conditions.description: SQL query matches prohibited destructive DDL statement invariant

rules.name: Block Autonomous Account/Customer Deletion
rules.description: Agents cannot invoke customer termination or record purge endpoints autonomously.

conditions.description: Only human super-administrators can authorize customer account purging

rules.name: Allow Read-Only SELECT Queries
rules.description: Permits safe read-only SELECT queries on approved analytics views.

conditions.description: Query begins with SELECT read invariant
